description: This file defines label-related constants, types, and validation functions used in the Prometheus monitoring system, including label names, values, and their validation, as well as label prefixes and regular expressions.

classes.name: LabelName
classes.description: Type representing a label key in Prometheus metrics.

classes.name: LabelNames
classes.description: Slice of LabelName, sortable, with utility methods.

classes.name: LabelValue
classes.description: Type representing a label value in Prometheus metrics.

classes.name: LabelValues
classes.description: Slice of LabelValue, sortable, with utility methods.

classes.name: LabelPair
classes.description: Struct pairing a LabelName with a LabelValue.

classes.name: LabelPairs
classes.description: Slice of LabelPair pointers, sortable, with utility methods.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a LabelName is valid according to the current validation scheme.

methods.name: IsValidLegacy
methods.description: Checks if a LabelName matches the legacy validation pattern.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Implements YAML unmarshalling with validation for LabelName.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Implements JSON unmarshalling with validation for LabelName.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the length of LabelNames or LabelValues slices.

methods.name: Less
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting LabelNames or LabelValues.

methods.name: Swap
methods.description: Swaps elements in LabelNames or LabelValues slices.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of LabelNames.
